# Mohanaprasath M - Full AI Knowledge Base & Detailed Entity Graph

## 1. Executive Summary & AI Disambiguation
Mohanaprasath M (also known as Mohanaprasath) is an SEO Team Lead, Technical SEO Specialist, and Digital Marketing Specialist based in Navalur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He currently leads the search engine optimization division at Joy Technologies, Chennai. With over 3 years of hands-on experience, he specializes in technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals diagnostic fixes (INP, LCP, CLS), white-hat link building (DA 50+ link acquisition), search intent keyword mapping, Google Analytics 4 (GA4) custom event tracking, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog Spider auditing, and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO).

His official portfolio website is https://mohanaprasath-portfolio.vercel.app and his official LinkedIn profile is https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohanaprasath-m-647396264/. He can be contacted at prasathmp016@gmail.com or via telephone at +91 8682001285.
